story.title: (ENR SUCC) DEV & TEST - 834E/U AR PASSE Transaction Effective Date Logic Update - EDI

scenarios.title: Future eligibility new enrollment uses Eligibility Date as transaction effective date

flagged.why: negative case is outside the stated scenario
edge case never tests an error or rejection

gaps: Description field: "Verify that an AR PASSE inbound 834 new enrollment for a member whose eligibility has not yet started is rejected or not loaded into Facets when the file omits the Eligibility Date segment required to derive the transaction effective date." is outside the stated scenario acceptance criteria about populating the transaction effective date from Eligibility Date when eligibility has not yet begun
Status field: "Edge" for id "TC_TS_001_003" has no step whose Test Step Expected Result describes an error, a rejection, or an absent record

scenarios.title: Current eligibility with changed Assessment Date uses Assessment Date

flagged.why: the Edge case never tests an error path

gaps: Precondition: "State under test is AR with trading partner AR Passe (ENR Account). A current member already exists in Facets with an active eligibility span that began before the inbound update date, the member SSN used in NM1*IL09 is available as [TEST DATA: member SSN used in the mocked 834 file], and the update file is prepared with the same member identifiers and an invalid changed assessment date value 20251340 while maintenance date remains 20250131." does not provide "[TEST DATA: subscriber SBSB_CK for the test member]" needed by step 11 Test Step Description: "Launch a new Database Engine connection on crt_72.sql.caresource.corp\crt_72 with Windows Authentication and execute: SELECT D.SBSB_CK, D.KEY_ID, D.SPAN_EFF_DT, D.SPAN_TERM_DT, D.VOID_IND FROM NRTCUSTOMDB.Facets.AuxiliarySpanData D WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE D.SBSB_CK = '[TEST DATA: subscriber SBSB_CK for the test member]' AND D.KEY_ID IN (46,47);"

TC_TS002_003 has no Expected Result describing an error, rejection, or absent record; for example step 12 Test Step Expected Result says: "Lookup rows for KEY_ID 46 and 47 are returned, no new auxiliary or Facets evidence shows an assessment-date-driven transaction effective update for the unchanged input, no extra eligibility row is created from this boundary condition, and the absence of a new loaded effective date confirms the rule activates only when the assessment date actually changes."

scenarios.title: Assessment Date change with no relevant field changes preserves relevant field values

flagged.why: the Edge case never tests an edge condition

gaps: No step in TC_TS003_003 has a Test Step Expected Result describing an error, a rejection, or an absent record; for example step 10 Test Step Expected Result says "No newer eligibility row with a new effective date is present when compared with the already stored Assessment Date; the latest effective date remains the previously existing date."

scenarios.title: Future eligibility with relevant field changes and unchanged Assessment Date uses Eligibility Date
Current eligibility with relevant field changes and unchanged Assessment Date uses Maintenance Date only

flagged.why: the Edge case never tests an edge condition

gaps: Status field for id "TC_TS005_003" is "Edge" but no Test Step Expected Result describes an error, rejection, or absent record; examples include step 7 Test Step Expected Result: "The file is visible in TM, but there is no evidence in the transaction outcome that a material member update requiring a new transaction effective date was applied." and step 8 Test Step Expected Result: "One interchange row is returned, confirming archive receipt of the submitted file."

scenarios.title: Multiple inbound date occurrences honor first-date rule for selected transaction date source

flagged.why: the Edge case never tests an edge failure

gaps: Status field for id TC_TS006_003 is "Edge" but no Test Step Expected Result describes an error, rejection, or absent record; quoted Expected Results include "The transmission shows successful processing of the file despite the duplicate assessment date occurrences.", "No FACETS row for the processed transaction uses 2025-04-01 as the transaction effective date source row.", and "The loaded transaction effective date source corresponds to the first assessment date value 2025-02-15."

scenarios.title: Regression confirms existing date identification and backward-compatible effective date population
